title: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
description:
The **Western Roman Empire** officially ended in 476 AD when the Germanic chieftain Odoacer deposed the last Roman emperor, Romulus Augustulus.

This marked the end of ancient Rome and the beginning of the Middle Ages in Europe. The Eastern Roman Empire (Byzantine) continued for another thousand years.

The fall was caused by economic troubles, overexpansion, military defeats, and internal corruption.
